import numpy as np, pandas as pd, os
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
assets=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
base='../persistent/stock_data'; macro=pd.read_csv('../persistent/index_data/DXY.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date')['close'].pct_change()
prices={a:pd.read_csv(f'{base}/{a}.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date')['close'] for a in assets}
rets=pd.DataFrame({a:s.pct_change() for a,s in prices.items()}).sort_index(); macro=macro.reindex(rets.index)
# DXY beta: trailing covariance(asset return,DXY return)/DXY variance; negative beta is defensive when dollar strengthens
fac=rets.rolling(60,min_periods=45).cov(macro).div(macro.rolling(60,min_periods=45).var(),axis=0)
fac=-fac
# only completed t information, forward one-day return
ics=[]; ranks=[]; byreg={}
for i,d in enumerate(rets.index[:-1]):
 x=fac.loc[d]; y=rets.iloc[i+1]
 z=pd.concat([x,y],axis=1).dropna()
 if len(z)>=8:
  ic=spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic
  ics.append((d,ic,len(z))); ranks.append(x.rank(pct=True))
ser=pd.Series([v for _,v,_ in ics],index=[d for d,_,_ in ics])
print('dates',len(ser),'avg_names',np.mean([n for _,_,n in ics]),'coverage',np.mean([n for _,_,n in ics])/15)
print('daily IC %.6f ICIR %.6f hit %.4f'%(ser.mean(),ser.mean()/ser.std(),(ser>0).mean()))
for h in [5,10]:
 vals=[]
 for i,d in enumerate(rets.index[:-h]):
  z=pd.concat([fac.loc[d],rets.iloc[i+1:i+h+1].sum()],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8: vals.append(spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic)
 q=pd.Series(vals); print('%dd IC %.6f ICIR %.6f n %d'%(h,q.mean(),q.mean()/q.std(),len(q)))
for p,(lo,hi) in enumerate([(2020,2022),(2023,2024),(2025,2026)]):
 q=ser[(ser.index.year>=lo)&(ser.index.year<=hi)]; print('regime',lo,hi,'n',len(q),'mean',q.mean(),'icir',q.mean()/q.std())
# rank turnover
rr=pd.DataFrame({d:fac.loc[d].rank(pct=True) for d,_,_ in ics}).T
print('rank_turnover',rr.diff().abs().mean().mean(),'recent_mean',ser[ser.index>='2025-01-01'].mean(),'recent_icir',ser[ser.index>='2025-01-01'].mean()/ser[ser.index>='2025-01-01'].std())
# signal artifact for provenance
out=pd.DataFrame({a:fac[a] for a in assets}); out.to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20260730_dxy_beta_signal.csv',index_label='date')

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_stock_daily_data,get_index_daily_data
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
px={}
for s in U:
 d=get_stock_daily_data(s,days=3000); z=d[['date','close']].copy(); z.date=pd.to_datetime(z.date); px[s]=z.drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').close
macro=get_index_daily_data('DXY',days=3000)
z=macro[['date','close']].copy(); z.date=pd.to_datetime(z.date); dxy=z.drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').close
close=pd.DataFrame(px).sort_index(); ret=close.pct_change(); mr=dxy.reindex(close.index).pct_change()
# DXY sensitivity: assets with negative/low beta to dollar shocks are defensive; use negative rolling beta as score
cov=ret.rolling(60,min_periods=45).cov(mr); var=mr.rolling(60,min_periods=45).var(); f=(-cov.div(var,axis=0)).replace([np.inf,-np.inf],np.nan)
for h in [1,5,10]:
 fw=close.pct_change(h).shift(-h); vals=[]; ns=[]
 for dt in f.index:
  a=pd.DataFrame({'f':f.loc[dt],'r':fw.loc[dt]}).dropna()
  if len(a)>=8 and a.f.nunique()>1 and a.r.nunique()>1: vals.append(a.f.corr(a.r)); ns.append(len(a))
 ic=pd.Series(vals).dropna(); print('h',h,'dates',len(ic),'meanN %.2f'%np.mean(ns),'IC %.6f ICIR %.6f hit %.4f'%(ic.mean(),ic.mean()/ic.std(ddof=1)*np.sqrt(252), (ic>0).mean()))
# annual regime daily
fw=close.pct_change().shift(-1); vals=[]
for dt in f.index:
 a=pd.DataFrame({'f':f.loc[dt],'r':fw.loc[dt]}).dropna()
 if len(a)>=8 and a.f.nunique()>1 and a.r.nunique()>1: vals.append((dt,a.f.corr(a.r)))
ic=pd.Series(dict(vals)); print('regime',ic.groupby(ic.index.year).agg(['mean','count']).round(5).to_dict())
r=f.rank(axis=1,pct=True); print('turnover %.6f'%r.diff().abs().mean(axis=1).mean(),'coverage %.4f'%(f.notna().sum().sum()/f.size),'period',close.index.min(),close.index.max())
# library rank correlation audit where possible
for name in ['peer_median_leadlag_5d','short_term_reversal_5d','risk_adjusted_momentum_20d']:
 print('library',name,'not computed')

import pandas as pd, numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
P={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date').close for s in U}
p=pd.DataFrame(P).sort_index(); r=p.pct_change();
# Residual momentum: 20d return relative to contemporaneous cross-asset median, volatility scaled.
raw=p.pct_change(20); peer=raw.sub(raw.median(axis=1),axis=0)
vol=r.rolling(40,min_periods=30).std()*np.sqrt(20)
fac=peer/vol
print('DATA',p.index.min().date(),p.index.max().date(),len(p),len(U))
for h in [1,5,10,20]:
  vals=[]; ns=[]; dates=[]
  for i in range(45,len(p)-h):
    z=pd.concat([fac.iloc[i],p.iloc[i+h]/p.iloc[i]-1],axis=1).dropna()
    if len(z)>=8:
      vals.append(spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic);ns.append(len(z));dates.append(p.index[i])
  q=np.array(vals); print('H',h,'dates',len(q),'avgN',round(np.mean(ns),2),'coverage',round(np.mean(ns)/15,4),'IC',round(np.mean(q),5),'ICIR',round(np.mean(q)/np.std(q,ddof=1),5),'hit',round(np.mean(q>0),4))
  for lo,hi in [(2020,2022),(2023,2024),(2025,2026)]:
    a=q[[lo<=d.year<=hi for d in dates]]; print(' regime',lo,hi,len(a),round(np.mean(a),5) if len(a) else None,round(np.mean(a)/np.std(a,ddof=1),5) if len(a)>1 else None)
rank=fac.rank(pct=True); print('turnover',round(np.nanmean(np.abs(rank.diff()).stack()),5))
print('corr existing raw mom',fac.stack().corr(raw.stack()),'corr reversal',fac.stack().corr((-p.pct_change(5)).stack()))

summary:
- Reviewed persistent factor library, ensemble, memory, and existing miner scripts. Current ensemble remains four factors: CLV 30%, peer lead-lag 30%, 5-day reversal 15%, and risk-adjusted 20-day momentum 25%; recent live performance through 2026-09-10 was +2.82% with Sharpe 9.20 and 0.40% max drawdown, though turnover/slippage and attribution remain unavailable.
- Historical admission context: prior candidates were generally rejected for redundancy or weak daily gates. The VIX-beta factor was independent but failed daily ICIR; downside reward ratio failed both IC and ICIR gates and was correlated with momentum. Warm-up/online execution had previously been frozen, but the latest cycle reports live results.
- Explored a new residual momentum factor: 20-day asset return relative to the cross-sectional median, scaled by 40-day volatility. Created `scripts/miner_2_20260910_residual_momentum.py`.
- Initial run accidentally included synthetic future rows through 2035, producing invalid regime coverage and misleading results. Corrected the script to cap data at 2026-09-10 and inspected asset date ranges.
- A further run exposed a pandas correlation implementation bug (`DataFrame.corr` used with a 2-D boolean mask) and terminated before producing reliable final statistics. No factor file was persisted, no ensemble changes were made, and no trading action was taken.

ys={1:{},5:{},10:{}}\\n for s in vals:\\n  ix=R[s].index;p=ix.get_loc(dt)\\n  for h in ys:\\n   if p+h<len(ix):ys[h][s]=R[s].iloc[p+1:p+h+1].sum()\\n z=[(v,ys[1][s]) for s,v in vals.items() if s in ys[1]]\\n if len(z)>=8:\\n  q=pd.Series([a for a,b in z]).corr(pd.Series([b for a,b in z]));ics.append(q);obs.append(len(z));reg.setdefault(dt.year,[]).append(q)\\n  for h in dec:\\n   zz=[(v,ys[h][s]) for s,v in vals.items() if s in ys[h]];dec[h].append(pd.Series([a for a,b in zz]).corr(pd.Series([b for a,b in zz])) if len(zz)>=8 else np.nan)\\n  rr=pd.Series(vals).rank(pct=True)\\n  if prev is not None: turn.append(np.mean([abs(rr[s]-prev[s]) for s in set(rr)&set(prev)]))\\n  prev=rr\\ndef st(a):\\n a=np.asarray(a,float);a=a[np.isfinite(a)];return len(a),float(np.mean(a)),float(np.mean(a)/np.std(a,ddof=1)),float(np.mean(a>0))\\nprint(\'dates\',len(ics),\'avg_names\',np.mean(obs),\'assets\',len(D),\'total_dates\',len(all_dates),\'coverage\',len(ics)/len(all_dates),\'turnover\',np.mean(turn));print(\'daily\',st(ics))\\nfor h,a in dec.items():print(str(h)+\'d\',st(a))\\nprint(\'regimes\',{y:st(a) for y,a in reg.items()})\\n","file_path":"scripts/miner_2_20260924_trend_consistency.py"}', call_id='call_o4Rx2lx3a6vmxvTcQbagamLf', name='write_file', type='function_call', id='fc_0c6d032a316df6a0016a847be70dbc87d0ab135b26992f387e', caller=None, namespace=None, status='completed')
